$comment: Runtime (npm audit --omit=dev) high/critical advisories accepted for a limited time. The audit gate (apps/api/scripts/audit-gate.js) fails on any unlisted high/critical advisory and on any expired entry. Fastify-chain entries: 60 days (Fastify 5 upgrade); everything else: at most 30 days.

exceptions.reason: Fixed only in @fastify/static 7+/8+, which needs Fastify 5 (deferred upgrade). Reachable: static serves apps/api/public (src/plugins/content.js:33), but no static route is behind a guard; everything under public/ is public by design.
Fixed in Fastify 5 only (deferred). Not reachable: no route declares a Fastify body schema (validation is zod inside handlers) and the JSON parser is our own (src/plugins/content.js).
Fixed in Fastify 5 only (deferred). Not reachable: needs async Fastify schema validation; no route declares a schema.
Fixed in Fastify 5 only (deferred). Not reachable as described: the only not-found handler is the root one (src/errors.js:180), and auth runs as route preHandlers, never inside a not-found handler.
Fixed in Fastify 5 only (deferred). Not reachable: no Fastify request schemas.
Fixed in Fastify 5 only (deferred). Not reachable: no Fastify header schemas.
find-my-way via Fastify 4; fixed with Fastify 5 (deferred). Not reachable: the app serves HTTP/1.1 only (no http2 option in index.js; Caddy terminates TLS and proxies HTTP/1.1).

tar 6 via bcrypt 5 -> @mapbox/node-pre-gyp 1 (needs tar ^6; fixed only in tar >= 7.5.21). Not runtime-reachable: bcrypt only calls node-pre-gyp find() (node_modules/bcrypt/bcrypt.js:3-5); tar is loaded only by node-pre-gyp's install/package commands (lib/node-pre-gyp.js:86) - install time only, extracting bcrypt's own release tarball. Fix: bcrypt 6 (drops node-pre-gyp) in a follow-up.
